value.hook: Read before reviewing delivery identity, spawn replay, native lease brakes, tmux batching or shared-build kills.
value.title: Delivery, spawn and launch review patterns (Nov 21-22)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Reviews from 2026-11-21 to 22 covered #316 and #319 to #333, all merged. Patterns worth reusing:

- Delivery identity (F270, #322): `from` is daemon-stamped on the shim, but caller-asserted on raw /v1/send outside replies (C33). Check every ledger WRITER for require_sender, not just admission. B322-01 was a '' row written at ack, and the '' wildcard then collapsed other senders. Replay keys must include the sender (`<len>:<from>:<msg_id>` is injective).
- Spawn keys (F255): spawn_id is an idempotency handle, not a capability. Check the shape before ANY path or env use. A replay returns only the descriptor. Evidence files live at $TMPDIR/pij-rs-spawn/<key>.*; F265 unlinks them on fresh keys.
- Native lease brakes (F268, F274): every writer of native_receivers.renewed_at goes through update_native_receiver → inbox_recipient(identity), and receiver_entry sets renewed_at on CREATE too (mongoose caught my "two writers" claim). Faking a renewal needs the native identity (C33).
- Log text: daemon-authored log or PA text must pass printable_path / is_one_line / render::seat BEFORE it is stored (#316 new-1, #325 note). Bidi format chars pass is_control.
- tmux batches (#330, #333): argv-only Command, '-t' targets are not format-expanded, and only an exact ';' element separates commands. Ownership (a local tap, or marker == expected_tap_sink) is decided before the batch, and later logic may only remove panes.
- shared-build (#326): kill only `-$pgid` of jobs started under `set -m`. Validate the env limits before taking the lock. Watch for bash arithmetic overflow failing open.
- Destructive sweeps (#332): name the POLICY input and check that every other guard only spares.
- Process: the bash tool refuses inline bodies containing `${...}`-like text, so use --body-file. When a reviewer pointer falsifies a claim, publish a corrected verdict or note at once and wake the pm.
